key_insight: G2Rec combines holistic graph-based user co-engagement modeling with semantic tokenization to produce more accurate, semantically grounded user interest prototypes for generative recommendation.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets industrial-scale sequential recommendation by improving context modeling while avoiding the scalability and locality limits of prior graph-based approaches.
method: Build a scalable graph-based model of user co-engagement to capture holistic behavioral context.
Tokenize item semantics with explicit supervision signals rather than heuristics.
Fuse behavioral and semantic context to generate user interest prototypes without ground-truth user interests.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong results from extensive experiments on public datasets and online deployment across product surfaces.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of graph construction and semantic tokenization, which could be sensitive to noisy interaction data or changing item vocabularies.
paper_title: Structuring and Tokenizing Distributed User Interest Context for Generative Recommendation
